. The file name says CNN, and the layers are locally connected layers with one-dimensional max-pooling. A locally connected layer uses a separate kernel at each position. It does not share one kernel across the image the way

program cnn_mnist_1d

    use nf, only: network, sgd, &
      input, maxpool, flatten, dense, reshape, locally_connected, &
      load_mnist, label_digits, softmax, relu
  
    implicit none
  
    type(network) :: net
  
    real, allocatable :: training_images(:,:), training_labels(:)
    real, allocatable :: validation_images(:,:), validation_labels(:)
    real, allocatable :: testing_images(:,:), testing_labels(:)
    integer :: n
    integer, parameter :: num_epochs = 20
  
    call load_mnist(training_images, training_labels, &
                    validation_images, validation_labels, &
                    testing_images, testing_labels)
  
    net = network([ &
      input(784), &
      reshape(28, 28), &
      locally_connected(filters=8, kernel_size=3, activation=relu()), &
      maxpool(pool_width=2, stride=2), &
      locally_connected(filters=16, kernel_size=3, activation=relu()), &
      maxpool(pool_width=2, stride=2), &
      dense(10, activation=softmax()) &
    ])
  
    call net % print_info()
The loader again requests training, validation, and test images.
makes each column a rank-2 array. In
the first dimension is the channel count and the second is the width, and the output of that layer is
rather than a rank-3 map. The width formula is the same valid-convolution size,

epochs: do n = 1, num_epochs
  
      call net % train( &
        training_images, &
        label_digits(training_labels), &
        batch_size=16, &
        epochs=1, &
        optimizer=sgd(learning_rate=0.01) &
      )
  
      print '(a,i2,a,f5.2,a)', 'Epoch ', n, ' done, Accuracy: ', accuracy( &
        net, validation_images, label_digits(validation_labels)) * 100, ' %'
  
    end do epochs
  
    print '(a,f5.2,a)', 'Testing accuracy: ', &
      accuracy(net, testing_images, label_digits(testing_labels)) * 100, '%'
  
  contains
  
    real function accuracy(net, x, y)
      type(network), intent(in out) :: net
      real, intent(in) :: x(:,:), y(:,:)
      integer :: i, good
      good = 0
      do i = 1, size(x, dim=2)
        if (all(maxloc(net % predict(x(:,i))) == maxloc(y(:,i)))) then
          good = good + 1
        end if
      end do
      accuracy = real(good) / size(x, dim=2)
    end function accuracy
The loop is 20 epochs, batch size 16, and SGD with learning rate 0.01, ten times the step used by
fraction on the validation images during the loop and on the test images once at the end. The contained
function is the same comparison as in the other two MNIST programs.

program cnn_mnist_1d

    use nf, only: network, sgd, &
      input, maxpool, flatten, dense, reshape, locally_connected, &
      load_mnist, label_digits, softmax, relu
  
    implicit none
  
    type(network) :: net
  
    real, allocatable :: training_images(:,:), training_labels(:)
    real, allocatable :: validation_images(:,:), validation_labels(:)
    real, allocatable :: testing_images(:,:), testing_labels(:)
    integer :: n
    integer, parameter :: num_epochs = 20
  
    call load_mnist(training_images, training_labels, &
                    validation_images, validation_labels, &
                    testing_images, testing_labels)
  
    net = network([ &
      input(784), &
      reshape(28, 28), &
      locally_connected(filters=8, kernel_size=3, activation=relu()), &
      maxpool(pool_width=2, stride=2), &
      locally_connected(filters=16, kernel_size=3, activation=relu()), &
      maxpool(pool_width=2, stride=2), &
      dense(10, activation=softmax()) &
    ])
  
    call net % print_info()
  
    epochs: do n = 1, num_epochs
  
      call net % train( &
        training_images, &
        label_digits(training_labels), &
        batch_size=16, &
        epochs=1, &
        optimizer=sgd(learning_rate=0.01) &
      )
  
      print '(a,i2,a,f5.2,a)', 'Epoch ', n, ' done, Accuracy: ', accuracy( &
        net, validation_images, label_digits(validation_labels)) * 100, ' %'
  
    end do epochs
  
    print '(a,f5.2,a)', 'Testing accuracy: ', &
      accuracy(net, testing_images, label_digits(testing_labels)) * 100, '%'
  
  contains
  
    real function accuracy(net, x, y)
      type(network), intent(in out) :: net
      real, intent(in) :: x(:,:), y(:,:)
      integer :: i, good
      good = 0
      do i = 1, size(x, dim=2)
        if (all(maxloc(net % predict(x(:,i))) == maxloc(y(:,i)))) then
          good = good + 1
        end if
      end do
      accuracy = real(good) / size(x, dim=2)
    end function accuracy
  
  end program cnn_mnist_1d
The package file below builds this source with fpm. The Fortran program itself is the file from the repository.

name = "Section_Examples_Cnn_Mnist_1d"

[build]
auto-executables = true
auto-tests = true
auto-examples = true

[install]
library = false

[dependencies]
neural-fortran = { git = "https://github.com/modern-fortran/neural-fortran.git" }

[[executable]]
name = "Section_Examples_Cnn_Mnist_1d"
source-dir = "app"
main = "cnn_mnist_1d.f90"
